sections.label: Head
sections.text:
Confused and depressed. Hci^dache with
nausea, vertigo; especially between eyebrows. Cannot
keep eyes open; spasmodic closure of lids.

sections.label: Chest
sections.text:
Superficial respiration; heart and lungs
feel paralyzed ; respiration slow. Heart beats sound to
him like boom of a drum.

sections.label: Relationship
sections.text:
Compare: Bapiisia; Lobelia Ciyrdinalis
(debility, especially of lower extremities ; oppressed
breathing, pleurisy, sticking pain in chest on taking a
long breath. Pain in left lung, intermitting pricking
during the day).
